title: Intoxicated Pregnant Woman Begs for Mom as Cops Arrest Her for DWI
description:
An officer pulled over a pregnant woman after observing her swerving in a school zone on a Wednesday night in West Long Branch, New Jersey. What happens next is described as a “game of cat and mouse” by the 31-year-old mother-to-be after a series of sobriety tests didn’t go as planned. Rather than owning up to her mistakes, the angry DWI suspect shifted the blame on the officers and claimed race was a factor at play.
